verdict.rationale: The evidence pack's own probe for Superpowers' agent-oriented docs page (docs.md) returned a 404, and the only successful llms.txt probe hit is GitHub's own generic file, not anything published by Superpowers/obra. While Superpowers ships SKILL.md files consumed internally by harnesses, there's no evidence of a dedicated llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation surface a user could point an external agent at.
